what: A WebGL wall bending an endless preview grid with a convex lens — cells wrap toward the panel edges, and the top blurs as frosted glass down under the copy child and melts into the background color. It drifts by itself at .05 cells/s, glides with inertia (.94/frame) when dragged, and the faster you drag the more the lens bends (max +.6). It tilts ±.06 cells toward the cursor, and a hovered cell lifts to light gray (.82/frame). Pressing fires fx:pick(number). At first it unfolds over 1.6s expo.out with a slight bend (.7× · lens +1.6), and as the panel is scrolled past the lens flattens and it half blurs

options.cell: Cell width ÷ panel width, default follows panel shape (landscape .26 · below 1.3 .36 · portrait .62)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: What goes in a cell (children, hidden) — if there is an img, that photo is used, otherwise a skin-color placeholder. data-title or text becomes the name below the cell
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: Text laid on top (child) — frosted glass blurs everything down to here
options.fx:pick: Event raised from the element when a cell is clicked (detail.index)
